  • Proficient with computer use (standard browser, word processing applications)
  • Able to read a manufacturing drawings, wiring diagrams and follow assembly instructions
  • Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a high-paced, challenging work environment
  • Ability to effectively communicate (verbal and written) with engineering and production
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience working in a R&D setting.
  • Demonstrated experience with many aspects of aircraft or ground systems fabrication, repair, assembly, and operation including structural fabrication, integration, composites fabrication, and avionics build/integration/test
  • Mechanically assemble complex electro-mechanical assemblies, high quality wire harnesses, test racks, junction boxes, and associated components involving hand soldering and component fabrication
  • Perform validation and testing of various electronic components using equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, network analyzers, and test racks
  • Experience with common air-frame construction techniques such as rivets, mechanical fasteners, nut plates, etc.
  • Prior hands-on experience with kit, model, or experimental aircraft builds
  • Electronic box assembly troubleshooting, and writing detailed issue tickets for failures
  • Running functional checkouts and tests, and diagnosing issues discovered during these processes
  • Assembly troubleshooting, and writing detailed issue tickets for failures
  • Testing and running RF systems
  • Troubleshoot extensively
  • Loading firmware onto integrated digital systems
  • Running LabView scripts
  • PCBA integration and troubleshooting
  • Basic understanding of LEAN manufacturing principles
  • Assist with kitting products, as needed
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (Engineering, Math, Hard Science, Business, etc.)
  • Holds an Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) license or has similar training
  • Forklift certification

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Willing to travel 15%
  • Willing to work assigned shift hours, overtime and weekends as needed. Estimated shift times: 1st shift: 7 AM - 3:30 PM; 2nd shift: 3 PM - 11:30 PM
  • Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position
  • Able to lift up to 25lbs. unassisted

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our rapidly growing EW team in sunny Costa Mesa, California.   • Experience supporting design and execution for advanced, combined hardware/software systems
  • Experience across both commercial product and defense industries
  • Proven ability to decompose and organize technically complex projects in a structured approach

  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities

ABOUT THE TEAM

We're seeking a mid-senior level product security engineer to own security for assigned products in your technical domain, provide expert consultation on security architectures, guide implementation of security features, develop solutions engineering for complex security challenges, and ultimately secure our suite of advanced technologies including artificial intelligence systems, command and control platforms, aerospace vehicles, and long range sensors.

The ideal candidate has a background in electrical or software engineering, with a focus on platform security, or has pivoted to a product or application security role. They will be able to conduct complex security architecture reviews, research and mitigate exploits against hardware and software, and work with other engineering teams to build resiliency into our products.

ABOUT THE JOB

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Owns the development and maturation of security features for Anduril’s products
  • Collaborates and builds solutions with engineering teams to meet and exceed industry-standard security goals
  • Collaborate with security assessment teams to assess Anduril’s products and integrated components to uncover potential weaknesses
  • Collaborates with manufacturing and operations teams to develop secure handling and operational processes
  • Engages with teams to remediate uncovered weakness in designs, implementations, integrations, and processes

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with one or more programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Golang, Rust, Python)
  • Experience assessing security of firmware, applications, network, IoT, or embedded systems
  • Experience developing features for and improving security of firmware, applications, network, or embedded systems
  • Experience building, testing, and delivering production-ready systems, especially for embedded and/or Linux systems
  • Familiarity with anti-tamper and reverse engineering mechanisms
  • Strong and professional communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Strong understanding of the "why" behind product, systems, and security design
  • A sincere commitment to a positive, inclusive, and collaborative culture
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Excels at the above listed Requirements
  • Possesses and able to maintain an active U.S. TS Security clearance with SCI and/or SAP eligibility
  • Familiarity with security architectures of embedded, aerospace, or cyber-physical systems
  • Fluency in modern USG cyber methodologies, including Cyber Survivability guidance and related policy (JSIG, ICD 503, CSEIG, SSECG, NIST SP 800-160, Cyber T&E Guidebook, CMMC, etc.)
  • Experience with programmable logic devices and their development tools
  • Regularly builds, tests, and delivers production-ready systems, especially for embedded and/or Linux systems

ABOUT THE JOB

As the Product Sourcing Engineer, Semiconductor, you will serve as the domain expert for semiconductor commodities across Anduril’s Intelligence Systems. In this high-impact, proactive role, you will secure the critical components, materials, and services that power our mission-critical hardware.

You will be responsible for developing new and existing supplier partnerships, integrating next-generation technologies, and optimizing cost, quality, and supply continuity across new and existing product lines.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • RFx & Sourcing: Lead RFI, RFQ, and RFP processes for strategic semiconductor components from inception to award.
  • Cost Analysis & TCO: Perform detailed cost-breakdown analyses on quote submissions, using Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) modeling to drive data-backed sourcing decisions.
  • Tactical Escalation & Crisis Management: Lead and participate in daily or weekly operational escalation forums to aggressively triage supply disruptions, resolve critical component shortages, and extinguish production-line blockers as they arise.
  • Engineering Collaboration: Partner with Engineering teams early in the development cycle to influence design specifications based on supply chain intelligence, availability, and lifecycle health.
  • Manufacturing & CTB Support: Partner closely with PCBA Contract Manufacturers (CMs) to resolve component shortages and ensure Clear-to-Build (CTB) milestones are consistently met.
  • Strategy: Develop and execute long-term strategies for semiconductor components, focusing on cost reduction and supply chain resilience.
  • Contract Negotiations: Draft, negotiate, and execute commercial agreements covering pricing, lead times, capacity commitments, warranties, and payment terms.
  • Market Intelligence & Trend Forecasting: Monitor global semiconductor market dynamics, fab capacity constraints, lead-time trends, geopolitical impacts, and technological shifts to proactively identify supply risks and strategic cost-saving opportunities.
  • Supplier Performance: Own end-to-end supplier relationship management, tracking key metrics across quality, delivery, cost, and innovation. Serve as the primary escalation point for commodity-related issues.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, or sourcing engineering with a focus on semiconductor components.
  • Proven ability to analyze cost structures and negotiate complex commercial contracts.
  • Eligible for U.S. Secret or TS clearance and ability to maintain clearance.
  • Ability to travel up to 15%.
  • Ability to work on-site in Costa Mesa, CA (relocation required if not local).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field.
  • Prior experience in the defense, aerospace, automotive, or high-reliability hardware industries.
  • Advanced expertise in TCO modeling and component lifecycle management.
  • Track record of building strong cross-functional relationships with Engineering, Quality, and Operations teams.
  • Highly adaptable self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can proactively unblock operational bottlenecks.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a Program Director to lead the execution of a new product line of critical network capabilities. This role is not just about leading; it's about re-envisioning the technical future of secure, resilient, and high-bandwidth communication for all of Anduril and the DoW’s autonomous platforms and integrated defense solutions. A successful candidate will not only have a strong technical background, but must also possess a vision for leadership that embraces Anduril’s mission to disrupt the defense technology ecosystem across technical and programmatic domains.

Success in this position hinges on three key facets:

  1. Systems and engineering mindset - the ability to understand and assess technical concepts. Identifying system dependencies, interfaces, technical risks and the impact of key architectural decisions with the engineering team.
  2. Execution focused - digging into the details, charting the path and owning the outcome. You will be expected to utilize your technical aptitude in conjunction with your program management, and leadership skills to deliver the best outcome for Anduril and the customer.
  3. Collaborative partnership - managing customer relationships and shaping the future of the program with the government.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • In partnership with the Engineering Leadership Team, own the development and deployment of Anduril’s secure communications technologies to meet the operational needs of the Department of War and Intelligence Community
  • Develop strong, trusting relationships with Anduril’s customers across all domains, ensuring we have tight feedback loops that enable us to shape solutions, rapidly iterate, and ultimately field solutions faster
  • Autonomously execute on broad and/or ambiguous requirements from internal engineering, customers, and third party corporate partners to own successful delivery of outcomes on multiple programs simultaneously
  • Monitor and manage program progress across cost, schedule, and resource allocation, making tradeoffs that enable us to deliver best-in-class solutions to our customers on-time and on-budget
  • Develop and implement lightweight processes, tools, and metrics for program planning, scope management, risk management, and customer communication to enable Anduril to move rapidly
  • Be high ownership on all pieces of work and become a trusted partner and advisor to Anduril’s engineers
  • Foster a creative, high-performance culture within the team, and proactively assess team skills versus needs, identifying personnel development or recruitment opportunities to strengthen the team’s capabilities
  • Collaborate with finance and business development teams to develop novel pricing strategies for proposals that set Anduril up for long term financial and operational success
  • Collaborate with senior management to develop and refine the strategic roadmap for R&D investments that underpin the success of our programs

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (technical background preferred)
  • Minimum of 8 years experience managing the development of complex technical systems throughout the product lifecycle
  • Experience supporting and/or leading engineering programs in the secure networking and communications domain
  • Proven track record of successfully managing complex, multi-million-dollar projects and driving their on-time, on-budget completion
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities with the ability to move seamlessly between tactical and the 30,000 ft level
  • Experience coordinating multiple internal and external teams within a complex engineering or technology-focused organization
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) Manufacturing Engineering team is seeking a Prototype Manufacturing Engineer to execute first builds and prototype manufacturing across our mechanical, structural, thermal management, and fluid systems (fuel, hydraulics, pneumatics) subsystems. This role spans the full AD&S portfolio of autonomous aircraft, cruise missiles, and loitering munitions – and is designed for an engineer who thrives in ambiguity, builds hardware with incomplete inputs, and treats every first build as an opportunity to generate the manufacturing knowledge that makes future production possible.

As a Prototype ME, you are the first manufacturing engineer on a new build. You will work from incomplete design definitions – often without released drawings or established work instructions – to figure out how hardware goes together, build the first units, and document what you learn. Your output is not just a built prototype; it is the MVP work instructions, preliminary BOM structure, buildability feedback, and lessons learned that the DFx and SME teams use to drive producibility improvements and prepare for rate production. You are the bridge between a design engineer's intent and the physical reality of how something gets built for the first time.

This is a cross-program role. You will move between AD&S programs based on where first builds are happening, bringing a consistent methodology to new hardware regardless of the product line. You will work closely with design engineers, DFx engineers, SME manufacturing engineers, and production technicians. The pace is fast, the inputs are messy, and the expectation is that you bring order to chaos – one build at a time.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Execute first builds of new mechanical, structural, thermal, and fluid system hardware across AD&S programs, working from preliminary or incomplete design inputs (unreleased models, draft drawings, verbal direction from design engineers).
  • Develop MVP work instructions during and immediately after first builds – capturing assembly sequences, tooling needs, critical dimensions, torque values, and process notes sufficient for a technician to repeat the build.
  • Establish preliminary BOM structures (Make/Buy determinations) based on first-build experience, identifying which components should be fabricated internally, procured, or sent to contract manufacturers.
  • Provide structured design feedback to design engineers based on first-build observations – specifically addressing buildability, checkability (can you inspect it?), and repeatability (can someone else build it the same way?).
  • Document lessons learned from every first build and feed them directly to DFx engineers for incorporation into formal DFM/DFA reviews and design trade studies.
  • Build and support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) units – Ironbirds, Copperbirds, and similar integration test articles – where the build method is undefined and must be figured out from scratch.
  • Identify and resolve manufacturing issues in real time on the shop floor during first builds, including fit/interference problems, fastener access issues, routing conflicts, and assembly sequence challenges.
  • Develop or source prototype tooling, fixtures, and assembly aids needed for first builds – balancing speed with enough rigor that the tooling concept can inform production tooling decisions later.
  • Work with SME manufacturing engineers to validate process assumptions – confirming that the manufacturing processes assumed in design (welding methods, composite layup approaches, tube forming techniques, adhesive bonding sequences) are feasible as designed.
  • Support the transition of hardware from prototype to early production by ensuring first-build documentation, lessons learned, and BOM structures are complete and transferred to the product-owning ME team.
  • Collaborate with quality engineering to identify inspection points and acceptance criteria that emerge from first-build experience – particularly for characteristics not yet captured in drawings or specifications.
  • Travel to production sites, supplier facilities, and integration locations to support first builds and prototype campaigns (~15-20%, depending on program needs).

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, prototype/development manufacturing, or NPI with hands-on involvement in building new hardware – not just sustaining existing production lines.
  • Demonstrated experience executing first builds or first-article production of mechanical or electromechanical hardware with incomplete or evolving design inputs.
  • Practical knowledge of mechanical manufacturing and assembly processes: CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, welding, mechanical fastening, composite fabrication, tube bending/swaging, adhesive bonding, and mechanical integration.
  • Ability to read mechanical drawings, interpret GD&T, and work from 3D models – and the judgment to know when something in the model won't work on the shop floor.
  • Experience writing work instructions, assembly procedures, or process documentation – you've captured a build process well enough that someone else could repeat it.
  • Strong communication skills and a willingness to give direct, specific design feedback to design engineers. You are not just flagging problems – you are proposing solutions.
  • Comfort working across multiple programs simultaneously, shifting between products as first-build needs arise.
  • A genuine interest in building things and a drive to figure out how hardware goes together. Personal experience in a machine shop, fabrication shop, or working on hardware (machining, welding, assembly, personal projects) is a strong plus.
  • Self-directed and resourceful – you don't wait for complete inputs or perfect information. You find what you need, make reasonable assumptions, and close the loop.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in aerospace or defense prototype/development manufacturing, particularly with structural, thermal, or fluid system hardware.
  • Exposure to Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) builds, integration test articles, or similar one-off/low-volume integration hardware.
  • Familiarity with AS9100 or similar quality management systems – enough to understand how prototype builds connect to production quality requirements.
  • Proficiency in CAD software (NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, or similar) sufficient to navigate models and identify manufacturing concerns independently.
  • Experience with composite manufacturing processes (layup, cure, bonding, machining) in a prototype or development context.
  • Experience with fluid system assembly – tube routing, fitting installation, leak testing, cleanliness requirements.
  • Familiarity with BOM management, ERP systems, or PLM tools used to structure manufacturing data.
  • Experience developing or sourcing prototype tooling and fixtures.
  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

We are looking for a Quality Engineering Specialist to join our electronic warfare program. This Quality Specialist is a professional who is responsible for monitoring, inspecting and proposing measures to correct or improve the final products in order to meet established quality standards. They are a highly motivated team player who is willing to support a fast paced team environment


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manages the site Materials Review Board (MRB) process
  • Inspect to verify non-conforming parts
  • Assist in the root cause analysis
  • Assist in the dispositioning of non-conforming material and ensure the tasks are completed in a timely manner
  • Manage internal re-work to support dispositions.
  • Support the troubleshooting of electrical subassemblies and PCBAs.
  • Ensure data collection and entry is accurate and complete for the MRB process
  • Troubleshoot PCBAs that fail functional testing
  • Inspect harnesses and PCBAs for conformance to design drawings and workmanship standards
  • Communicate the process performance and quality issues to key stakeholders to drive improvements
  • Execute vendor return material authorization (RMA) with partnership between Warehouse and Buyers to ensure material leaves the MRB area for suppliers.
  • Perform Verification First Article Inspection (FAI) on incoming material and coordinate acceptance of FAI data submitted by suppliers.
  • Manage quality containment process for material, tooling, and inspection equipment that are involved in non-conformances impacting production capacity and capability.
  • Create inspection plans for incoming material, in-process inspection steps, and end of line inspection, as per direction from product quality engineers
  • Train technicians and inspectors to execute inspection plans and data capture in the process.
  • Propose, develop and implement quality assurance policies and procedures and review with the product quality engineers
  • Review and propose continuous improvement projects for productivity gains, quality improvements, and benefits to Anduril's quality policy.
  • Support the calibration process by conducting recalls, managing the calibration database, and logistics with third party calibration services, as per the direction of the product quality engineers.
  • Perform internal audits on processes and procedures, as per direction from Quality Systems Engineer
  • Deep dive into data and traceability investigations to identify trends, oddities, inconsistencies, and variation that impacts the effectiveness of processes, procedures, and product quality.
  • Stay current with new inspection technologies and techniques and recommend improvements to the inspection process

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Associate degree or equivalent in a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in electro-mechanical hardware development
  • Experience with electronics manufacturing, assembly and test
  • Experience troubleshooting PCBAs that fail functional testing.
  • Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings (wire diagrams, work instructions, CAD)
  • Analyze inspection results and provide feedback to production, manufacturing engineering, and quality engineering departments.
  • Experience using investigative equipment such as x-ray inspection, digital characterization, material certificate of compliance, etc.
  • Experience in a facility with AS9100, ISO9001, IATF 16949 or similar QMS standard
  • Experience with validation and testing assemblies and their components
  • Experience with communicating with suppliers and cross functional teams
  • U.S. Person Status is required as this position needs to access controlled data

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Technical or Associates degree in related quality/mechanical/aerospace engineering field
  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, Quality Improvement Associate, or equivalent.
  • IPC-A-610 or IPC-A-620 Certification
  • Knowledge of 6 sigma, TQM, TPS, Lean, Low Rate Production
  • Experience with inspection of Electrical and Electronic Components (Power Supplies, PCBs, wire-harnesses)
  • Experience with Manufacturing processes and their related systems (Jira, MES, ERP, Teamcenter, CAD)
  • Experience with auditing processes and procedures in a manufacturing environment
  • Detail oriented self starter with minimal oversight - strong ability to communicate with different cross functional teams.

ABOUT THE JOB 

As the R&D Engineering Technician, you will collaborate closely with development and test engineers to create and evaluate innovative optical systems for various platforms, including airborne, maritime, and space applications. You will be responsible for fabricating high-quality electro-mechanical assemblies and managing the rapid prototyping process, ensuring all projects are executed efficiently and effectively. Additionally, your expertise in troubleshooting and assembly will be crucial as you oversee internal prototyping resources and support external testing initiatives. The Anduril Imaging business line is developing infrared camera systems at the highest priority level designated by the Department of War. This role will be directly working with the engineering team and be crucial to the success of these development efforts.  

WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

  • Work closely with development and test engineers to build and test new infrared optical systems for airborne, maritime and space platforms 
  • Fabricate and assemble high quality, high reliability and electro-mechanical assemblies. 
  • Develop and implement integration and test fixtures; setup and use existing test equipment, monitor, and report the results. 
  • Own internal prototyping resources, including mechanical and electrical fabrication equipment 
  • Manage R+D space from a facilities and organizational standpoint 
  • Travel to external laboratories and test sites as needed. 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of experience as an electro-mechanical technician working on high-precision micro-assemblies, vacuum systems, or wafer-handling equipment. 
  • Rapid Prototyping Ownership: Proven ability to manage R&D builds from concept to completion with minimal oversight—including sourcing components, assembling, testing, and troubleshooting. 
  • Electrical Fundamentals: Strong working knowledge of basic electrical principles (e.g., Ohm’s Law, calculating voltage drop, sizing wire gauges based on current/amperage). 
  • Harness & Cable Fabrication: Hands-on experience building, routing, and troubleshooting custom wiring harnesses and power cables, including precision soldering, pin crimping, and connector assembly. 
  • Process Documentation: Ability to document assembly workflows, redline engineering drawings, and draft initial Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) from a technician's viewpoint. 
  • Work Environment: Comfortable wearing full cleanroom attire (gown, mask, gloves) and following strict ESD-control protocols. 
  • Preferred (Nice to Have): 
  • Background in the Defense, Aerospace, or Near-Infrared (NIR) / Optical industries. 
  • Experience operating within certified cleanrooms (Class 1,000 / 100 or better). 
  • Familiarity with ISO quality management systems and 5S lean manufacturing methodologies. 
  • Soldering certifications (e.g., IPC J-STD-001 or IPC-A-610) are a strong plus.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance 

PREFFERED QUALIFICATIONS:  

  • Experience with the alignment and characterization of optical systems 
  • NPI (new product introduction) and ability to train / lead others to scale up 
  • Experience with test and measurement equipment (Instron, CMM, optical comparator, etc.) 
  • Familiarity with Mechanical and Electrical Software tools (Solidworks, Altium) and scripting/automation languages (Matlab, Python, Labview) as GUI.

We are seeking a visionary and technically proficient Radio Frequency Machine Learning (RFML) Operations Lead to lead our advanced research and development initiatives. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in one or more of the following areas: RF Sensing, Statistical Signal Processing, Wireless Systems (particularly 5G), and Time/Frequency Analysis of Signals. In this role, you will drive the creation and implementation of innovative RFML models and solutions that advance our capabilities in these cutting-edge domains.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead and inspire a team of RFML engineers. Develop and execute the strategic vision for integrating machine learning into RF sensing, signal processing, and wireless communication systems.
  • Spearhead the design and development of advanced RFML models for wireless communication applications like RF spectrum sensing, channel equalization and estimation, channel modeling. Innovate and push the boundaries of what’s possible in these fields.
  • Provide deep technical expertise in wireless systems, particularly 5G technologies, to inform the development of algorithms and models that enhance system performance maintaining latency and compute budget.
  • Identify and tackle complex challenges in the areas of signal processing and wireless systems using advanced RFML techniques. Lead initiatives to explore and implement novel solutions.
  • Oversee multiple concurrent projects, ensuring they are completed on time and within scope. Allocate resources effectively and manage project risks to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Mentor and develop team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. Stay up to date with the latest advancements in RFML and related fields to guide the team effectively.

REQUIREMENTS

  • PhD. or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with a focus on RFML, signal processing, or wireless systems.
  • A minimum of 7+ years of experience in the related field.
  • Strong background in wireless communications and digital signal processing.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a team of engineers, with a track record of successful project delivery.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Deep understanding of current trends and advancements in RF sensing, statistical signal processing, and wireless systems, particularly 5G.
  • Some travel required.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience in managing entire RFML engineering lifecycle – from data capture to model development to model training to system testing and optimization.
  • Experience with real-time signal processing, DSP platforms, or mixed-signal embedded systems.
  • Ability to write and / or review production level code (Python, C++) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Software Defined Radios.

As a Senior SecOps Analyst, you will serve as an incident commander alongside other senior analysts. WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Participate in threat modeling scenarios with cross-functional partners to understand weaknesses across Cloud, Mobile, Endpoints, and other environments incorporating findings into security controls and/or detection signatures
  • Organize and conduct threat hunting and data baselines to identify anomalous patterns in data
  • Participate in an on-call rotation responding to security events and conducting incident response investigations while effectively communicating findings to key stakeholders. As a Senior SecOps Analyst, you will serve as an incident commander as necessary.
  • Proactively collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, guiding detection and response maturity of key worlds, leading incidents and large-scale data baselines, and being responsible with mentoring and guiding junior analysts.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in security monitoring, log analysis, and detection engineering within large data sets across endpoint, network, and a wide variety of application log sources
  • Experience in Python development, specifically contributing to a shared codebase used for automating SOC operations
  • Must have experience with one or more SIEM languages (SPL, KQL, SQL)
  • Experience conducting analysis in a data lake environment
  • Broad range of practical security knowledge across the spectrum of endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud infrastructure
  • Knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) across Windows, Linux, MacOS, AWS/Azure, etc.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Modeling & Simulation engineer to join our team. If you have a passion for flight and like the idea of building a physics based digital representation of a flying vehicle this is the role for you!

    • Develop simulation solutions for 6DOF and Guidance, Navigation and Control algorithm development

    • Characterization work (aero, optics, actuators, IMUs, etc) for both fixed wing and rotorcraft

    • Develop models required to support functional evaluation of GNC software
  • Required Qualifications

 

    • Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering or a related field with exceptional skills in the field of dynamic systems and control
    • 8 years professional experience in a Modeling & Simulation for supporting airborne platforms
    • Demonstrated proficiency in C++, Matlab, Simulink, Simulink Embedded Coder, and Python
    • Extensive experience in modeling and simulation of linear/nonlinear dynamic systems
    • Experience in Monte-Carlo simulations and flight test data analysis tools and processes
    • Extensive experience in the mathematical modeling and simulation of aerodynamics, rotorcraft dynamics, sensors and actuators.
    • Work with multi-disciplinary subject matter experts to understand and adequately model pertinent sub-system, system and system of system dynamics
    • A passion for defending the Unites States of America and its allies
    • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

 

  • Preferred Qualifications

 

    • Master’s Degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, or a related field with a focus on dynamic systems and control
    • Experience with Flight test data processing/sim correlation experience

ABOUT THE JOB

We’re looking for people who love ontologies - defining domains and writing the code that puts those models into action. ABOUT THE JOB

This role is central to our People Data & Analytics team, where you will be instrumental in building and maintaining the robust data infrastructure that powers our strategic insights. You'll own the full data lifecycle, from ensuring accurate ingestion and integration of diverse HR data sources, to designing, developing, and optimizing data models and pipelines. WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, build, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines to reliably ingest, integrate, and transform diverse people data from various HR systems (HRIS, ATS, LMS, etc.) into our data platform.
  • Develop, maintain, and govern scalable and secure data models, schemas, and ontologies specifically for people analytics, ensuring data quality, consistency, and accessibility for downstream consumption.
  • Contribute to the strategic design, development, and evolution of our people data platform and tooling, advocating for engineering best practices, automation, and a scalable analytics ecosystem (e.g., leveraging SQLMesh, Iceberg, Flyte).
  • Partner closely with People Analysts, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders to understand their analytical needs and translate them into robust data solutions, providing well-structured, documented, and reliable datasets.
  • Implement and monitor data quality checks, identify discrepancies, troubleshoot data issues, and ensure the reliability and integrity of people data across all systems.
  • Continuously monitor the performance of data pipelines and models, identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions to ensure the efficiency and scalability of our people data infrastructure.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for data pipelines, models, and processes, and champion data engineering best practices (e.g., version control, testing, CI/CD) within the team.
  • Implement and enforce strict data security measures and ensure all data handling practices comply with internal policies and external regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) related to employee data privacy.
  • Collaborate with broader enterprise analytics and data engineering teams to align on data architecture standards, integrate people data with other business domains, and contribute to the overall evolution of the company's data platform.

  • Deep understanding and proven experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining robust data models (e.g., dimensional modeling, Kimball methodology) for analytical purposes.
  • Hands-on experience building and optimizing complex ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines using modern tools such as dbt, Apache Airflow, Flyte, Dagster, or similar orchestration platforms.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across diverse teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Strong technical foundation in data engineering, with expertise in SQL, Python, and experience working with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).

ABOUT THE JOB

The Senior BOM Sourcing Engineer for Intelligence Systems (internally known as a Senior Product Sourcing Engineer), drives the strategic supply network development and cost management of Anduril’s product hardware across their lifecycles, by collaborating with suppliers and cross-functionally, including folks in engineering, quality, and manufacturing. You will be the end to end owner of supply chain for the Anduril Intelligence & Space business line, responsible for engineering support, vendor onboarding & development, as well sourcing, pricing, and negotiating for the total Bill of Material (BOM).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Deep dive into your engineering Bill of Material (BOM), working closely with engineering to ensure parts being designed can be sourced & procured at a reasonable target level
  • Conduct supplier selection for a specific product, leveraging our approved supplier list as well as working to onboard unique vendors to support the needs of the Space & Intelligence business team
  • Drive on time delivery utilizing unique solutions to break the mold of traditional Space industry lead-times and supply constraints
  • Partner with strategic suppliers to accelerate product development via activities such as:
    • Concept scoping to quickly solidify requirements
    • Feature trade-off/trade tables
    • Should cost/clean sheet models
    • Joint design development, via clear statements of work
    • Simulation of mechanical & electronics designs
  • Drive the development and consolidation of a manufacturing BOM, working with Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing, to ramp production internally and with our suppliers with high flexibility
  • Manage total cost of the program, including NPI & mass production  throughout NPI
  • Conduct value-stream mapping to optimize supply network lead time and flexibility
  • Complete the BOM risk assessment, include alternate component sourcing, etc.
  • Ensure completion of all component qualifications, ahead of production
  • Reduce complexity: commonality optimization & component/supplier rationalization
  • Lead all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle
  • Manage ad-hoc cost issues e.g., tariffs / import export cost, and cost inflation
  • Managing supply issues as they arise, ensuring on time delivery at or below target cost

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or other technical field 
  • 8+ years of experience in sourcing engineering, supplier engagement and development, or design of electronics and/or mechanical devices
  • Domain expertise of value/procurement engineering or TCO-related work at the component & product level
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
  • Ability to travel 10% - 40% of the time, variable based on program needs
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Ashville, OH
  • This role will be based temporarily at Santa Ana, CA for a 3 month training period before transitioning to Ashville, OH

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree or advanced technical degree
  • Deeper experience within:
    • Design & development of electronics and/or mechanical devices
    • Advanced sourcing activities, including stints as commodity/sourcing managers
    • Supplier development (technology, process, supply chain, etc.)
    • Early supplier engagement, ahead of product/engineering requirement realization
  • Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment
  • Exposure to working in a fast-pace, start-up environment
  • Direct experience in the Space industry
  • Experience negotiating and managing commercial subcontracts

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Experience using various camera systems, including Arri, Red, and Sony

  • A team player who is highly collaborative, with the ability to handle multiple projects, and communicate effectively with stakeholders
  • Must be able to carry and lift loads up to 50lbs

ABOUT THE TEAM

Quality Intelligence supports data and AI in Anduril's manufacturing quality organization through three distinct areas: Analytics, Manufacturing AI, and Vision Inspection. Analytics owns end-to-end data and analytics work that directly drives impact for Anduril's product quality engineers on the factory floor. Our customers are program quality leaders, manufacturing engineers, and operators across sites and programs. The work encompasses building scorecards that catch quality drift before customers do, pipelines that turn ERP / MES / QMS data into decisions, and AI tools that compress hours of manual triage into minutes.

We operate hub-and-spoke. HQ builds platform-grade analytics centrally; site engineers localize and run them at each manufacturing site. This is the site analytics lead role at our Atlanta facility. You are the resident analytics engineer and the person accountable for what Quality Intelligence has deployed here. Atlanta already has production dashboards and pipelines running; you will own them, keep them accurate, and improve them as programs evolve. Beyond maintaining what exists, you will build new analytics products as the site takes on new programs and requirements from the floor. Most of this role is hands-on build; the rest is running the site as a program: gathering requirements from operators and engineers, sequencing the work, driving rollouts to completion, and feeding what you learn back into the HQ roadmap.

This role is subject to ITAR. Applicants must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.


WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Intersection of Analytics and Manufacturing: You will operate at the intersection of hardware manufacturing and data analytics. You are not afraid to spend time on the shop floor analyzing quality workflows, building analytics tools for said workflows and implementing them in well-designed, actionable dashboards.
  • Production Data: You'll pull from production systems (ERP, MES, QMS, inventory), build pipelines and ontologies in Palantir Foundry and Databricks, and partner with manufacturing engineers, ML practitioners, and program quality leads to ship analytics products operators depend on.
  • Develop and Operate Site Analytics: You will design, build, and operate the production dashboards, pipelines, and quality metrics inspection-data analytics the site runs on. Well thought out decisions you make set the pattern for future programs.
  • Run intake and priorities for the site: Hold a standing feedback loop with operators, manufacturing engineers, and program quality. Turn what you hear into a prioritized, visible backlog — what you can configure this week, what needs HQ build time, and what we are deliberately not doing — and file crisp, evidence-backed asks back to HQ so the platform gets better.
  • Investigate data quality: When a dashboard is inaccurate or a number looks wrong, you are the lead investigator. Deep-dive analysis in SQL and Python, trace problems through the stack, identify the root cause, and fix it at the source.
  • Drive technical improvements: You will implement robust data-quality checks, validation rules, and automated monitoring directly in the pipelines. Your data is trusted because you made it provably trustworthy.
  • Build AI-Assisted Analytics Tools: Small apps and workflows in Foundry / Databricks that reduce repetitive analyst work by 10x, grounded in what you have learned from operators on the floor.
  • Lead Data Projects End-to-End: Partner with cross-functional teams from requirements through deployment. Translate program quality leads' problems into data products that already exist or can be configured quickly and own the rollout.
  • Drive Adoption: A dashboard nobody opens is ineffective. You will train operators, run office hours, track usage, and treat adoption as a deliverable you own, not a downstream side effect.
  • AI Use: You will be expected to use AI aggressively in your own work: to draft pipelines, write tests, generate dashboards, explore unfamiliar data, and accelerate the repetitive parts of the job.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field from an accredited engineering program.
  • 4+ years in a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or similar role with at least 1 year applied data experience in hardware product engineering environment.
  • You understand how manufacturing works: the workflows, the quality gates, and how manufacturing data drives or degrades quality outcomes. You are willing to work in and around manufacturing operations, including time on the production floor.
  • Experience with Foundry, Databricks or an equivalent cloud lake house. You have built and maintained pipelines and dashboards other teams depend on. 
  • Strong SQL on large, multi-source datasets: joins across heterogeneous systems, window functions, and performance tuning. 
  • Strong applied experience using AI (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, AIP) with ability to review AI-generated artifacts critically. You are aware of the mistakes AI tools can make, with a clear view of where they help and where they don't.
  • Demonstrated root-cause analysis on complex data issues. When a number looks wrong, you can trace it back through the stack and explain why. 
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (this role is subject to ITAR). 
  • You communicate plainly: to a director without jargon, to an engineer without losing precision. 
  • Travel up to 25% to Anduril sites and vendors. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting analytics for hardware manufacturing (NPI, ramp, high-volume) across any of ERP (Oracle, NetSuite, SAP), MES, QMS, PLM (Teamcenter), or inventory / warehouse systems.
  • Strong Python for data transformation and scripting (Pandas, PySpark, or equivalent).
  • Experience as an embedded or site-resident engineer at a manufacturing or industrial site, or standing up systems and data at a greenfield facility.
  • Familiarity with quality methodologies: RCCA / 8D, FMEA, GD&T, IQC / OQC, control-plan design.
  • Defense or regulated-manufacturing experience (ITAR, AS9100, IPC-610, MIL-STD-1916, or similar).
  • Software engineering practices: Git, code review, CI, and testing data code with the same rigor as application code.
  • Experience integrating LLMs or ML models into analytics workflows: RAG over operational data, AI-assisted triage, or agentic data exploration.
  • Experience mentoring or leading a small team of engineers or analysts.

ABOUT THE JOB

We’re looking for Data Engineers who are seeking high impact collaborative roles focused on driving operational execution. Ideally you are looking to learn what it takes to build the next generation of defense technology. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the design and roadmap for our data platform
  • Partner with operations, product, and engineering to advocate best practices and build supporting systems and infrastructure for the various data needs
  • Own the ingest and egress frameworks for data pipelines that stitch together various data sources in order to produce valuable data products that drive the business
  • Palantir Foundry is our central hub for data driven applications, visualizations and large scale data analysis across the Anduril org. We manage a large user base and provide true data self service at scale.
  • We use SQLMesh for data transformations, giving our engineers the ability to work with SQL while enjoying software engineering best practices like version control, testing, and CI/CD for data pipelines.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Hands-on proficiency with electronic test equipment — oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum/network analyzers, power supplies/loads, and data acquisition systems

  • Experience with signal integrity and power integrity validation (eye diagrams, jitter analysis, PDN measurements)
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and instrument control (SCPI, VISA, python based test frameworks)
  • Experience validating designs intended for harsh or deployed environments (ruggedized, airborne, or space)

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) Manufacturing Engineering team is seeking a Senior DFx Engineer to drive design for manufacturability, assembly, and cost across our mechanical, structural, thermal management, and fluid systems (fuel, hydraulics, pneumatics) subsystems. This role spans our full portfolio of autonomous aircraft, cruise missiles, and loitering munitions — ensuring that design decisions account for how hardware will be built, by whom, and at what cost.
You will bring specialty expertise in at least one of the following domains: mechanical structures and assemblies, thermal/heat transfer systems, or fluid systems including fuel, hydraulic, and pneumatic architectures. Your primary focus areas are manufacturability, assembly, and cost. You will work directly with subject matter expert (SME) manufacturing engineers and design engineers to evaluate producibility, negotiate design trades, and drive improvements that make hardware buildable and cost-effective.
A key part of this role is supporting the selection and qualification of contract manufacturers — assessing supplier capabilities against DFx requirements and helping ensure that external production partners can deliver to the quality, rate, and cost targets our programs demand. This is an inherently cross-functional role: you will work daily with supply chain, quality, operations, and program teams in addition to ME and DE.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Execute DFx analysis across mechanical, structural, thermal, and fluid systems subsystems for AD&S programs, with a primary focus on manufacturability, assembly, and cost.
  • Participate in and help lead structured DFM/DFA/DFC reviews at key design milestones, applying rigorous scoring to identify producibility and cost risks and drive design changes before they reach production.
  • Participate in and help lead/facilitate DFMEAs with cross-functional teams. Use FMEA outputs to drive design changes, inspection strategies, and control plans.
  • Work directly with SME manufacturing engineers and design engineers to evaluate designs, translate manufacturing constraints into actionable feedback, and support design trades that balance performance, producibility, and cost.
  • Support the selection and qualification of contract manufacturers for machined components, fabrications, composite structures, thermal hardware, and fluid system assemblies — assessing supplier manufacturing capability, process maturity, and cost competitiveness against DFx requirements.
  • Participate in supplier manufacturing assessments including facility reviews, process audits, and capability evaluations.
  • Contribute to should-cost models and cost-driver analyses for mechanical and fluid system assemblies, identifying design changes that reduce unit cost without compromising quality or performance.
  • Develop and maintain DFx standards, guidelines, and scorecards specific to mechanical manufacturing processes including CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, welding, brazing, composite layup and bonding, tube bending and swaging, and mechanical assembly.
  • Analyze designs across key lenses — manufacturability/assembly, cost structure, adherence to specification, process capability, and technology maturity — to contribute to quantified risk assessments that inform engineering and program decisions.
  • Evaluate thermal management and fluid system designs for producibility — including tube routing, fitting selection, seal and joint design, heat exchanger fabrication, and cleanliness requirements.
  • Partner with supply chain to align DFx requirements with sourcing strategy, ensuring that designs are producible by the suppliers we intend to use.
  • Collaborate with quality engineering to ensure DFx findings flow into inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and supplier quality requirements.
  • Close the loop between production floor feedback, supplier performance data, and upstream design improvements.
  • Contribute to the DFx toolkit — templates, scoring rubrics, cost models, lessons-learned databases, and training materials — so that DFx knowledge scales across the organization.
  • Travel to production sites, contract manufacturers, and supplier facilities (~20%, depending on business needs).

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, producibility engineering, or DFx with a significant focus on mechanical systems, thermal management, or fluid systems — with specialty expertise in at least one of these domains.
  • Strong working knowledge of mechanical manufacturing processes: CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, welding, brazing, composite layup and cure, bonding, casting, forging, and complex mechanical assembly.
  • Experience participating in or leading DFM/DFA reviews and translating findings into measurable design improvements that reduce cost and improve producibility.
  • Experience supporting contract manufacturer evaluations — including facility assessments, process capability reviews, or production readiness evaluations.
  • Understanding of cost drivers in mechanical and fluid system production, with exposure to should-cost modeling or cost analysis.
  • Ability to read and critically evaluate mechanical drawings, GD&T, 3D models, and assembly documentation for producibility and cost impact.
  • Working knowledge of relevant standards and specifications for aerospace mechanical and fluid systems.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally across design engineering, manufacturing engineering, supply chain, quality, and operations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present DFx and cost findings to engineering teams and drive alignment on design changes.
  • Comfortable working across multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Personal experience in a machine shop, fabrication shop, or on a production floor working with mechanical hardware. Hands-on credibility matters.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree in engineering or a related field.
  • Specialty expertise in two or more of: mechanical structures, thermal/heat transfer systems, fuel systems, hydraulic systems.
  • Experience in aerospace or defense mechanical production, particularly with qualified or flight-critical hardware.
  • Familiarity with AS9100/AS9102 quality management systems and First Article Inspection processes.
  • Experience with composite manufacturing (autoclave cure, out-of-autoclave, RTM) and associated DFM considerations.
  • Proficiency in CAD software (NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, or similar) sufficient to review designs independently.
  • Background in Design of Experiments (DOE), statistical process control, or Six Sigma applied to mechanical manufacturing.
  • Experience with Full Size Determinant Assembly (FSDA).
  • Experience with value engineering or formal cost reduction programs in a production environment.
  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance with Full-Scope Polygraph.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Discovery is Anduril's team for the hard concepts: the ones that are not yet proven or built. We take the newest and hardest problems across space, missiles, air, sensors, autonomy, and cyber, decide what is worth building, and prove it out: we build the models, break the assumptions, run the tests, and carry what works to the point where a program can pick it up. We work with hardware and software engineering teams across the company, driving cross-functional collaboration across different business lines. 

ABOUT THE JOB

We are building an expeditionary force: a small group of engineers who want to do big, new, hard things and who move into unfamiliar territory as a matter of course. As a Discovery Engineer you pick up a concept nobody has proven, learn whatever domain it lives in, build the analysis or prototype that tests it, and get to an answer. The problems change; the approach does not: reason from first principles, do the work, check it, and reach a solution.

You are not hired for a particular skill set. You are hired for a record of getting engaged in problems across different areas, being analytic, testing new concepts, and getting to solutions. You are also the adversary to our own ideas. The rigor that validates a good concept is the same rigor that kills a bad one early, while it is still cheap, and you apply it to your own work first.

This is a hands-on technical role on both internally and externally funded programs within Anduril's Discovery Business Line, on operationally relevant timelines.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own new concepts from first idea through analysis, prototype, and test, and drive them to a validated answer
  • Learn new domains fast enough to do real work in them: read the references, build the model, check it against known results, then extend it
  • Build or adapt the models, simulations, and test setups the question needs, using existing tools where they fit and building where they do not
  • Pressure-test your own and others' work: hunt failure modes, surface hidden assumptions, and stress trade studies before decisions are locked in
  • Use AI tools as a force multiplier for research, code, and analysis, and know when their output has to be checked against a reference
  • Work shoulder to shoulder with Hardware, Software, GNC, and the other teams at Anduril, and translate results into decisions that change the design
  • Communicate results to engineers, leadership, and customers, including strong visual presentation of complex data

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance
  • Demonstrated experience working in more than one technical area
  • You have done things: designed, built, tested, or fielded something real, in any field
  • Proficiency in at least one physics-math scripting environment (Python with numpy/scipy, MATLAB/Simulink, Julia, or similar)
  • Strong written, verbal, and visual communication

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years in a relevant science/engineering field
  • Math, physics, or engineering degree, or similar
  • Proficiency with AI tools (coding assistants, agents, model-driven research) in day-to-day engineering work, and judgment about when to trust their output
  • Experience in several of: space systems, missiles and missile defense, air vehicles, GNC, sensors and sensor fusion, radar, EW, acoustics, autonomy, or similar. Breadth across these counts for more than depth in any one
  • Familiarity with domain analysis tools as relevant (STK/Astrogator, AFSIM, HFSS, Fluent, or similar)

ABOUT THE JOB

The Space Imaging team is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join the team. The Space Imaging team is responsible for all aspects of spaceborne EO/IR system development, from the ideation stage through initial production. In this role, you will work closely with an interdisciplinary technical team to define the electrical architecture of space-qualified EO/IR sensor payloads — including power distribution, connector/harness interfaces, EMI/EMC protection, and high-speed communication interfaces — build and test prototypes, and mature designs into flight hardware products. As needed, you will also lead small teams of engineers from concept through system definition and development.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Electrical Architecture: Define and own the electrical architecture for EO/IR sensor payload assemblies, including power distribution, connector/harness interfaces, grounding/bonding schemes, and communication interfaces.
  • Power Electronics Design: Design, analyze, and test isolated power conversion, EMI filtering, inrush current limiting, and over-voltage/reverse-polarity protection circuitry for low-voltage DC payload power systems.
  • Interface & Harness Design: Select connectors, define pin assignments, perform wire/cable and component derating analyses, and establish shielding, bonding, and isolation schemes to meet EMI/EMC requirements.
  • Communication Interfaces: Design and support high-speed Ethernet (10GbE) and discrete I/O (RS-422, I2C, SPI) interfaces between sensor electronics and host avionics.
  • EMC/ESD: Support EMI/EMC qualification testing (MIL-STD-461/464), and ESD protection design. 
  • Radiation Compliance: Radiation-tolerant (TID/SEU) component selection for space and tactical environments.
  • Parts Stress & Reliability Analysis: Perform EEE parts stress/derating analyses and support hybrid microelectronics selection to ensure reliable operation across mission life.
  • Hardware/Software Integration: Collaborate with firmware, mechanical, optical, and systems engineers to integrate electrical designs into sensor payload assemblies, including bring-up and verification testing.
  • Testing and Validation: Develop and execute test procedures using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, network analyzers, EMI test gear) to validate designs against functional and performance requirements.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: A Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field is typically required.
  • Experience: 8+ years of experience designing power, interface, or mixed-signal electronics for space, airborne, or other harsh-environment defense systems.
  • Power Electronics & Circuit Design: Experience designing isolated DC/DC power conversion, EMI filters, and transient/over-voltage protection circuits for low-voltage DC systems.
  • EMI/EMC Standards: Familiarity with MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-464 (or equivalent) EMI/EMC design and test methods.
  • Interface/Harness Design: Experience with connector selection, pin/harness definition, and parts/wire derating analysis (e.g., per MIL-HDBK-1547A or equivalent).
  • Debugging Skills: Strong hardware debugging skills using standard lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic/protocol analyzers).
  • Analysis Tools: Proficiency with schematic capture/circuit simulation tools and worst-case stress/derating analysis.
  • US Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Experience designing radiation-tolerant electronics and performing TID/SEU analysis for space systems
  • Experience with high-speed digital/communication interfaces (10GbE, SERDES) and signal integrity analysis
  • Familiarity with machine-vision/sensor communication protocols (e.g., GigE Vision)
  • Experience with hybrid microelectronics packaging (MIL-PRF-38534) or similar high-reliability component standards
  • PCB layout experience (e.g., Altium, Cadence) for mixed-signal or RF boards
  • Familiarity with electro-optical/infrared sensor payload electronics (detector bias/readout, cryocooler drive electronics)
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux/firmware interfaces to support electronics bring-up

Anduril’s Planning team is seeking a world-class Senior ERP & Scheduling Specialist to join our team. The role has an integral role at Anduril, having material flow responsibility throughout the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished goods shipped to customers. They will have full ownership of Planning of assemblies and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build. This hire will be instrumental in signaling material status and planning inventory levels, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Material Planning

  • Clear-To-Build Planning: Evaluate Engineering and Manufacturing Bills of Material (BOMs), and program demand for final assemblies to generate accurate, long-range material signals via Purchase Requisitions to align with known program demand and published production schedules. Track PO commitments to assess readiness for manufacturing to execute scheduled work.
  • Demand & Supply Alignment: Partner with Engineering, Configuration Managers, Program Managers, Procurement, and Production Schedulers to ensure all engineering activity and procurement effort completion supports demand and production schedule timelines
  • Shortage Mitigation & Inventory Strategy: Proactively identify material constraints, manage critical shortage escalation processes, and establish optimized inventory levels (safety stock, min/max) to ensure uninterrupted production.
  • KPI & Material Governance: Establish, monitor, and drive continuous improvement on key performance indicators (KPIs) focused on material availability, schedule attainment, inventory accuracy, and on time delivery(OTD).

Supply Planning

  • Material Orchestration: Coordinate closely with the Production Scheduler and Warehouse to assist precise product prestaging, picking, and kitting requirements.
  • Work Order Lifecycle Management: Own the generation, scheduling, and management of manufacturing work orders. Manage aging work orders and dynamically adjust schedule priorities based on real-time material availability, capacity and production changes.
  • Traceability & Compliance: Maintain robust serialized parts and material traceability using system tools and processes within the ERP to meet rigorous Quality Management System (QMS), defense, and HazMat standards.

ERP & MRP System

  • MRP: Act as the owner of material planning logic in MRP: ensure all lead times, reorder points, and master data parameters under the items master configuration and planning applications are regularly evaluated for accuracy.
  • Planning Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with Procurement, Engineering, and Production to continuously refine ERP workflows, ensuring the system is highly effective for MRP.
  • SME Support & Training: Troubleshoot MRP-related issues for end-users, design systemic solutions, and provide training to help build Planning Department capability.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience & Education: 5+ years of experience in Material Planning and/or Supply Planning.
    Academic coursework or a technical degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Advanced Analytics: Experience utilizing Ai-driven data tools to build custom tracking material requirements, inventory health, and scheduling metrics.
  • Planning: Must have experience with ERP/MRP systems. Understanding and working knowledge of Capacity Planning, JIT, Kanban, and Integrated Master Schedules (IMS). Ability to work in high volume & high pace environment.
  • Regulatory Standards: Experience managing government-furnished material under Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) guidelines.
  • Purchase Requisitioning: Extensive experience creating, managing, and optimizing purchase requisitions
  • Quality & Continuous Improvement: Experience working within AS9100 quality systems and applying Lean Manufacturing/Six Sigma principles to reduce material & process waste.

ABOUT THE JOB

We’re looking for a Senior Director to join the finance team supporting Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S), one of Anduril’s largest and fastest-growing divisions. This is a high-visibility financial leadership role responsible for owning the P&L for Anduril’s Autonomous Air Power business line within AD&S. This role is responsible for leading and developing a high-powered team that partners with business to drive product and program profitability.

The successful candidate will operate at both the strategic level — architecting sustainable financial models and shaping the division’s capital allocation — and the operational level — embedding with division and business line leaders to drive day-to-day financial rigor. This role will interface cross-functionally with senior leadership across finance, operations, production, engineering, growth, program management, and supply chain to shape and execute on the business line’s long-term business objectives.

This is a builder’s role — Fury is just the beginning.

ABOUT THE TEAM

AD&S is fundamentally reshaping the way future peer to peer conflicts are fought by developing next generation collaborative combat aircraft (like our unmanned fighter jet Fury), advanced effects (like our air-breathing cruise missile Barracuda), and the autonomy software that powers these weapons. The team is responsible for taking products from initial concept to full-rate production at-scale. The team also develops Lattice for Mission Autonomy, Anduril’s premier software platform that enables masses of Fury, Barracuda, and other robots to collaborate across various missions and environments. Our autonomous systems are the cornerstone of these capabilities, and we continually strive to push the boundaries of the possible in terms of range, autonomy, and mission capability.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Daily partnership with Senior Leaders within AD&S to bring first class financial expertise and support to the business.
  • Manage the processes for financial forecasting and budgets, and oversee the preparation of business line, product and program level financial reporting.
  • Own the financial oversight and management for a portfolio of large, complex, and mission-critical programs
  • Manage and scale a dedicated team in line with the needs of the business by developing and hiring best-in-class talent and implementing best practices and tools to ensure a well-controlled yet flexible finance organization.
  • Lead the development of executive-level reporting and present financial insights to senior management.
  • Evaluate financial performance by comparing and analyzing actual results with forecasts, highlighting trends and analyzing causes of unexpected variances.
  • Work with senior AD&S and corporate finance leaders to identify and implement ways to improve business performance and finance systems, tools and processes.
  • Get deep in the operations and support the team in creating bottoms-up, data-driven models to understand segmentation, pricing optimization, scenarios, and financial returns of our products and investments.
  • Own performance dashboards, alerting, and investigation into KPI health. Assess the impact of financial decisions on KPIs while developing strategies which drive demonstrable impact against these metrics.
  • Develop deep relationships with our customers (both internal and external) and oversee customer program reporting, monthly invoicing, and monthly financial status reporting.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, financial modeling and data analysis tools, and experience with financial reporting tools and ERP systems (i.e. Oracle Fusion, Oracle EPM, Anaplan, Foundry).

ABOUT THE JOB

The Imaging team is seeking a Senior Firmware Engineer to design a new product lines. In this role, you will work closely with an interdisciplinary technical team to define, complete the design and analysis, build prototypes leading to ground and flight testing, and mature the prototypes into products.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead FPGA architecture, standards, development and review processes
  • FPGA Development: Designing, architecting, simulating, and integrating VHDL designs into FPGAs or Systems on Chip (SoC) for optimized performance, resource utilization, and power efficiency.
  • Hardware/Software Integration: Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams (electrical engineers, software engineers, systems engineers) to ensure seamless integration of the firmware with the overall system, including processor bring-up and board support packages.
  • Testing and Validation: Developing robust test benches in VHDL/Verilog and utilizing lab tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers for rigorous testing and validation of designs against functional specifications and performance requirements.
  • Optimization: Optimizing the algorithms for hardware acceleration, including MIPS optimization and efficient use of on-chip bus protocols like AXI or AXI-Stream. 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: A Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field is typically required.
  • Experience: 10+ years of experience developing HDL firmware for FPGA devices 
  • Hardware Description Languages: Expertise in VHDL and/or Verilog/SystemVerilog is essential for RTL (Register Transfer Level) design.
  • FPGA Tools: Experience with industry-standard FPGA design tools such as Xilinx Vivado or Intel Quartus.
  • Debugging Skills: Strong hardware/software debugging skills using standard lab equipment.
  • Version Control: Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., Git) for collaborative development.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Demonstrated experience designing with multi-gigabit SERDES, DDR memory busses, Ethernet MAC and PHY interfaces, FPGAs, and common communication busses like SPI and I2C
  • Embedded software development experience with the use of timers, interrupts, hardware peripherals such as SPI controllers and ADCs
  • Knowledge of embedded Linux development, including device trees, hardware drivers, bootloaders, and basic Unix/Linux tools
  • Familiar with common programming languages like Python and MATLAB
  • Familiarity with infrared image sensor technology

The Imaging team is seeking a Senior FPGA Verification Engineer to help design a new product lines.   • Perform detailed analysis of quote submissions based on cost breakdown from data. Deep dive into every element of the supply chain and make data-driven decisions based on TCO
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to support prototype requirements, execute against build milestones, and lead sourcing activities

  • Collaborate internally, negotiate the right tradeoffs, solicit cooperation and resolve problems, and advance new supplier or product offerings
  • Provide strong technical direction within the specific commodities, by evaluating and guiding product strategy throughout the product lifecycle
  • Manage and lead the operations effort of developing new and adaptations of existing technologies for Anduril
  • Develop & execute commercial agreements to properly reflect the expectations of project, which include fixed and variable costs, lead-times, schedules, manufacturing capacities, etc
  • Conduct regular technology reviews to Executive staff and management
  • Own the supplier performance management of their respective commodities, which includes key delivery, quality, cost, and innovation metrics
  • Act as the primary escalation for their respective commodity

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, or related technical field
  • 8+ years of experience in supply chain commodity management of composites manufacturing, and/or sourcing engineering
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or metallurgical/materials engineering
  • Previous experience in defense, aerospace, automotive, high tech, or related industry
  • Well-versed in TCO analysis to ensure data-driven analytics tied to component and supplier selection, in a product-based ecosystem
  • Strategic thinker, experienced putting together commodities strategy/roadmap with key engineering stakeholders
  • Proven leadership in driving and influencing other teams to a common goal. You know how to effectively communicate and collaborate cross functionally and with all levels within an organization
  • Can wear different hats and it a strong team player to help your team move forward.
  • You are fluent in other cross functional areas to fill gaps and remove roadblocks when needed
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance
